text:
zoe_fin: Budget alert fired this morning for Sept: GPU spend is ~14.2k over the monthly forecast and the realtime budget dashboard shows a concentration in `trial_burst` tags that are currently unassigned to a customer. Can SRE/Platform confirm origin? :alarm_clock:

mike_sre: Looking now. I can see a sudden surge of ephemeral clusters created by the trials runner between 2024-09-18T01:10 and 2024-09-18T05:40 UTC. Many had label `trial=beta-2024` but missed `customer_id` which our billing mapping expects. Ingest dropped them to `unallocated`.

anya_sales: That window corresponds to a large enterprise trial we kicked off last week (Acme Inc.). If those GPU hours are customer-pass-through, Sales needs to surface the client approval for billing. Estimated pass-through exposure = $6,100.

leo_platform: Root cause: trials-runner template default omitted `customer_id` env when it launched in autoscale mode. We patched the deploy yesterday. Historical rows weren't remapped. Ops can run a reprocess with mapping `trial=beta-2024 -> customer:ACME-123` for that date range.

zoe_fin: Finance position: we need to separate (A) internal allocation for unapproved trial usage and (B) customer pass-through lines. Proposal: apply a correction that assigns pass-through lines to ACME-123 where there's matching trial metadata and Sales confirms client approval; otherwise reallocate to SALES-TRIALS internal reserve. Can Sales confirm which subset is billable?

anya_sales: I have the signed trial agreement for Acme with pass-through clause. I'll compile the list of instance_ids and mark which ones are billable. Uploading CSV to gs://billing-backfills/2024-09-acme-trial-claims.csv in a minute.

budget-alert-bot: Budget monitor: alert ID BA-20240918-77 triggered. Current overage: $14,234. Alert routed to #finance and #eng.

mike_sre: Suggest reprocess command: `python infra/tools/reassign_customer.py --input gs://billing-backfills/2024-09-acme-trial-claims.csv --map "trial=beta-2024:customer=ACME-123" --apply --note "trial backfill per Sales approval"` Also will snapshot ledger before running.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline: reprocess job queued (#12001) by mike_sre. ETA 30m. Output will be written to gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-09-acme-realloc-12001.csv

zoe_fin: For accounting treatment: if Sales confirms a line is customer-billable we will issue an invoice adjustment for Acme and tag ledger entries as CUSTOMER-PASS-THROUGH. For any remaining internal trial hours we will allocate to cost center SALES-TRIALS and reserve PLATFORM-TRIAL for a small Platform share if necessary. Proposed split for residual internal hours = SALES-TRIALS:0.85;PLATFORM-CORE:0.15. Approvals: VP Finance + Sales Director needed for any customer invoices.

anya_sales: I approve marking 62 of the 87 instances as customer-billable for Acme. Will DM VP Sales and attach the signed snippets.

leo_platform: Platform lead approved the residual split 85/15 for internal allocation (DM). I'll review ledger PR once reprocess completes. Also opening a config PR to add a validation to trials-runner so it fails deploy if `customer_id` is empty for autoscale templates: `infra/validators/require_customer_id.py`.

billing-bot: Job #12001 completed. Summary: 87 instances scanned, 62 assigned to ACME-123 (customer pass-through $6,100.00), 25 reallocated internally (total $8,134.00). Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-09-acme-realloc-12001.csv

zoe_fin: Ledger PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/512 with before/after rows and audit note. Includes tags: CUSTOMER-PASS-THROUGH, SALES-TRIALS, PLATFORM-CORE and accounting codes SALES-TRIALS and PLATFORM-CORE. Tagging @anya_sales for customer invoice adjustment approval and @vp_finance for final sign-off.

anya_sales: Uploaded signed trial agreement snippets to the PR and confirmed customer billing approval. Requesting Finance to issue invoice adjustment for Acme for $6,100.

budget-alert-bot: Budget monitor: overage now resolved after reallocation. Alert BA-20240918-77 closed.

zoe_fin: VP Finance approved the invoice adjustment in email. I'll create the customer credit memo and post reversal entries once invoice is issued. For internal allocations, ledger PR merged and entries posted. Closing this loop unless teams spot downstream anomalies. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
